Privacy Policy

Last Updated: September 16, 2026

JC Infinity Events LLC respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains what information we may collect through our website and services, why we collect it, and how it may be used.

1. Information We May Collect

When you contact us, submit an availability form, request a quote, or book a service, we may collect information such as:

  • name;
  • email address;
  • phone number;
  • event date;
  • event type;
  • venue or event location;
  • estimated guest count;
  • package or service interest;
  • event details or messages you voluntarily provide;
  • invoice, payment, or booking-related information.

We may also receive basic technical information generated through normal website use, such as browser type, device type, general usage information, or similar analytics data if website analytics are enabled.

2. How We Use Information

Information may be used to:

  • respond to inquiries;
  • check event-date availability;
  • prepare quotes, estimates, invoices, and agreements;
  • communicate about bookings;
  • provide delivery, setup, pickup, and event services;
  • process payments;
  • provide customer support;
  • maintain business and tax records;
  • improve our website and services;
  • prevent fraud or misuse;
  • comply with legal or regulatory obligations.

3. Event and Guestbook Recordings

Video and audio guestbook recordings may contain images, voices, names, personal messages, or other information voluntarily provided by event guests.

These recordings are collected for the purpose of providing the booked guestbook service to the client.

JC Infinity Events LLC does not intentionally use private guestbook recordings for advertising or social media without permission.

Recordings may be temporarily stored while they are processed and delivered to the client.

Stored Company copies may be deleted approximately 30 days after digital delivery.

Clients are responsible for downloading and securely preserving their delivered recordings.

4. Payment Information

Payments may be processed through third-party payment processors such as Square or other payment providers used by JC Infinity Events LLC.

JC Infinity Events LLC does not necessarily receive or store complete payment-card information entered directly into a third-party payment processor.

Payment providers maintain their own privacy and security practices.

5. Information Sharing

JC Infinity Events LLC does not sell customer personal information.

Information may be shared only when reasonably necessary with:

  • payment processors;
  • website hosting or form providers;
  • email or communication providers;
  • accounting or bookkeeping providers;
  • contractors or service providers assisting with legitimate business operations;
  • government or legal authorities when required by law.

Service providers should receive only the information reasonably necessary to perform their function.

6. Website Forms

Information submitted through the website's contact or availability forms is used to respond to the inquiry and evaluate availability.

Submitting a form does not create a confirmed booking or automatically reserve an event date.

7. Cookies and Analytics

The website may use cookies or similar technologies necessary for website functionality, analytics, security, or performance.

Third-party hosting or analytics providers may also collect technical information according to their own privacy policies.

8. Social Media

The website may link to JC Infinity Events social-media accounts.

If you visit or interact with external platforms such as Instagram or Facebook, information collected by those platforms is governed by their respective privacy policies.

9. Data Retention

JC Infinity Events LLC retains business records for as long as reasonably necessary for booking administration, accounting, tax, legal, dispute-resolution, and business purposes.

Guestbook recordings may be deleted approximately 30 days after delivery, as described above.

10. Data Security

JC Infinity Events LLC takes reasonable steps to protect customer information.

However, no website, online transmission, cloud-storage service, or electronic system can guarantee absolute security.

Customers should avoid sending highly sensitive information through ordinary website contact forms unless specifically requested through a secure method.

11. Children's Privacy

The website and booking services are intended for adults arranging events.

JC Infinity Events LLC does not knowingly use the website to solicit personal information directly from children.

Guests at events may appear in event recordings with the knowledge and responsibility of the event host or responsible adult.

12. Your Choices

You may contact JC Infinity Events LLC to:

  • update inaccurate contact information;
  • ask questions about information you previously submitted;
  • request that we stop non-essential marketing communications.

Certain information may still need to be retained for tax, accounting, contractual, legal, fraud-prevention, or dispute purposes.

13. Third-Party Links

The website may contain links to third-party websites or services.

JC Infinity Events LLC is not responsible for the privacy practices, security, or content of third-party websites.

14. Changes to This Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated as the business, website, or applicable requirements change.

The latest version will be posted on the website with the updated effective date.

15. Contact

Questions about this Privacy Policy may be directed to:

Terms & Conditions

Last Updated: September 28, 2026

These Terms & Conditions apply to rental and service bookings with JC Infinity Events LLC. Specific packages, services, equipment, inclusions, pricing, taxes, and approved add-ons are identified in the Client's invoice or accepted estimate and Rental & Service Agreement.

1. Reservation and Payment

A 50% non-refundable retainer of the total invoice amount is required to reserve the Client's event date.

The remaining balance is due seven (7) days before the event date.

The event date is not officially reserved until the required retainer has been received and the Rental & Service Agreement has been signed.

JC Infinity Events LLC may cancel delivery or setup if the remaining balance is not paid by the due date.

2. Refundable Security Deposit

A refundable security deposit of $150.00 is due with the final balance, no later than seven (7) days before the event.

The security deposit is separate from the rental price and is held to cover loss or damage to JC Infinity Events LLC equipment during the rental period.

The security deposit will be returned within five (5) business days after pickup and inspection of the equipment, provided the equipment is returned in substantially the same condition as delivered, excluding normal wear and tear.

JC Infinity Events LLC may deduct reasonable and documented repair or replacement costs for loss or damage caused by the Client or the Client's guests. Any remaining balance of the security deposit will be refunded to the Client.

3. Cancellation Policy

The 50% booking retainer is non-refundable once the event date has been reserved.

If the Client cancels more than fourteen (14) days before the event, any amount paid above the non-refundable retainer will be refunded.

If the Client cancels fourteen (14) days or less before the event, all payments made toward the rental or service are non-refundable.

Any refundable security deposit that has already been paid will be returned, provided no rental equipment has been delivered or placed at risk.

If the Client has paid the full rental or service balance and cancels more than fourteen (14) days before the event, JC Infinity Events LLC will retain the 50% retainer and refund the remaining rental or service amount paid.

4. Rescheduling

Requests to reschedule are subject to availability.

If JC Infinity Events LLC is available on the new requested date, the Company may transfer the Client's payments to the new date.

If the new date is unavailable, the cancellation terms above will apply.

5. Rental Period

Unless otherwise stated in the Client's invoice or accepted estimate, the selected guestbook package includes up to six (6) hours of guestbook availability.

The six-hour period begins at the agreed guestbook start time, not when JC Infinity Events LLC arrives for setup.

Additional time must be approved in advance and may require an additional fee.

6. Equipment Ownership

All rental equipment remains the property of JC Infinity Events LLC.

The Client receives temporary use of the equipment only and may not sell, loan, transfer, alter, repair, dismantle, or remove the equipment from the event location without permission.

7. Client Responsibility for Equipment

The Client agrees to take reasonable care of all rental equipment while it is at the event.

The Client may be financially responsible for loss or damage caused by theft, misuse, intentional damage, unauthorized movement, spills, water exposure, negligence, or improper handling by the Client or the Client's guests.

Normal wear and tear and equipment failure not caused by the Client or guests are excluded.

If equipment is damaged or lost, JC Infinity Events LLC will provide reasonable documentation of repair or replacement costs. If those costs exceed the security deposit, the Client remains responsible for the documented balance.

8. Delivery, Setup and Pickup

The Client must provide accurate venue information and reasonable access for delivery, setup, and pickup.

The Client is responsible for obtaining any venue permission required for the guestbook setup.

The Client is responsible for confirming that the venue provides sufficient doorway, pathway, elevator, loading, and setup-space access for all equipment included in the selected package or service.

JC Infinity Events LLC is not responsible for delays caused by venue restrictions, incorrect information, lack of access, inaccessible loading areas, or other circumstances outside the Company's control.

9. Placement and Power

The Client must provide a safe and suitable location for the guestbook setup.

The setup must be protected from rain, excessive moisture, unstable surfaces, excessive heat, or other conditions that could damage the equipment.

If electrical power is required, the Client or venue must provide access to a functioning electrical outlet.

10. Outdoor Events

Outdoor placement must be approved by JC Infinity Events LLC.

JC Infinity Events LLC may move, disconnect, or remove equipment if weather or environmental conditions create a risk of injury or equipment damage.

This includes rain, lightning, strong winds, flooding, excessive heat, or other unsafe conditions.

11. Guest Recordings

Guests voluntarily create their own video and audio messages.

JC Infinity Events LLC does not control what guests record and is not responsible for inappropriate, offensive, incomplete, accidental, or unwanted messages.

JC Infinity Events LLC cannot guarantee that every guest will use the guestbook or that every attempted recording will be completed successfully.

12. Technical Issues

JC Infinity Events LLC will make reasonable efforts to provide properly functioning equipment.

Electronic equipment may occasionally experience unexpected technical issues.

If a significant equipment failure caused by JC Infinity Events LLC prevents substantial use of the service, JC Infinity Events LLC may provide an appropriate partial or full refund depending on the circumstances.

To the extent permitted by law, JC Infinity Events LLC is not responsible for consequential damages, emotional damages, lost opportunities, or losses exceeding the amount paid for the affected service.

13. Digital Delivery and Recordings

Available recordings will be transferred and delivered to the Client after the event.

The Client is responsible for downloading and creating permanent backups of delivered recordings.

JC Infinity Events LLC may delete stored event recordings thirty (30) days after digital delivery.

The Client should therefore save and back up all files promptly.

14. Keepsake USB (If Included)

If a keepsake USB is included in the selected package, add-on, invoice, or accepted estimate, it will contain available event recordings.

Any keepsake USB provided is an additional copy and should not be treated as the Client's only permanent backup.

15. Venue and Guest Conduct

JC Infinity Events LLC is not responsible for injuries, losses, or damages caused by the Client, guests, venue staff, vendors, or other third parties.

The Client agrees not to allow guests to climb on, intentionally damage, tamper with, or improperly move any guestbook equipment, display, booth, stand, signage, or other rental item included in the selected package.

16. Photos and Marketing

Private guest recordings will not be used for JC Infinity Events LLC advertising or social media without permission.

The Client may separately authorize JC Infinity Events LLC to photograph the guestbook setup for portfolio or promotional purposes.

17. Limitation of Liability

To the extent permitted by law, JC Infinity Events LLC's total liability arising from a rental or service will not exceed the amount actually paid by the Client for the affected rental or service, except where applicable law requires otherwise.

18. Rental & Service Agreement

The Client's signed Rental & Service Agreement, together with the Client's invoice or accepted estimate identifying the selected package, services, equipment, inclusions, add-ons, and pricing, and any written changes agreed to by both parties, represents the agreement between JC Infinity Events LLC and the Client.

Any changes must be agreed to in writing.
